questions.q_en:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the equation correct?

24 ÷ 5 X 150 + 15 - 100 = -26
questions.solution_en:
We have the original equation as:-

24 ÷ 5 X 150 + 15 - 100 = -26

On checking each option one by one, after interchanging we get:-

Option (a): + and -

24 ÷ 5 X 150 - 15 + 100 = -26

720 - 15 + 100

820 - 15

805 ≠ -26

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (a) is incorrect

Option (b): ÷ and X

24 X 5 ÷ 150 + 15 - 100 = -26

0.8 + 15 - 100

15.8 - 100

-84.2 ≠ -26

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (b) is incorrect

Option (c): ÷ and +

24 + 5 X 150 ÷ 15 - 100 = -26

24 + 50 - 100

74 - 100

-26 = -26

LHS is equal to RHS.

Thus, option (c) is correct

Option (d): X and -

24 ÷ 5 - 150 + 15 X 100 = -26

4.8 - 150 + 15 X 100

4.8 - 150 + 1500

1504.8 - 150

1354.8 ≠ -26

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (d) is incorrect

questions.q_en: Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. Only two people sit to the right of U. Only two people sit to the left of R. Only two people sit between U and Q. Only three people sit between R and V. T is not an immediate neighbour of U. S sits to the right of U. Who sits to the immediate right of U?
questions.solution_en:
Only two people sit to the right of U.

Only two people sit to the left of R.

Only two people sit between U and Q. There is no place to the right of U which means Q will sit to the left of U.

Only three people sit between R and V. There is no place to the left of R which means V will sit to the right of R.

T is not an immediate neighbour of U. Which means T will sit at the right most corner.

S sits to the right of U. There is only one place for S to sit.

Now, we are left with only one place for P to sit.

From the above arrangement, S is sitting to the immediate right of U.
